IMPORTANT
=========
The build container does not provide Windows PowerShell, so Windows-runtime certification is deliberately deferred to the VPS installation gates.
The package must not be called live-certified until the pre-reboot, clean post-reboot, and RDP stability certificates pass on ABUTRON-PROD-01.
